title: Flametal tower shield

infobox.Crafting Materials: Ashwood x20, Flametal x8, Asksvin hide x4

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Flametal tower shield is the sixth tower shield, craftable from Ashlands materials. It currently has the highest block armor value of any shield in the game.
It has more block power compared to the Flametal Shield but reduces movement speed by 10%.
As a tower shield, it cannot be used to parry enemy attacks.
